interpretation: Shared skeletal landmarks strongly support a common native body coordinate frame. Names alone are unsafe for merging: hand and foot contain a same-named distal interphalangeal capsule; pelvis femur is truncated; named limb nerves include different proximal/distal extents. Regions are delivered separately and have not been spatially registered or merged.
